thread:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT 4102034567 — high latency and elevated errors observed on model family ventus11b (us-west-2). TPM spiked ~3x, p50 normal but p95/p99 elevated. paging: @Kai (oncall)

Kai: saw the alert, grabbing it. checking qps by tenant now.

Maria: ping — I just pulled SLO dashboards, p95 jumped from 180ms -> 900ms, error rate 5.1% (5xx from runtime). Looks like a tail event, likely KV cache churn.

Raj: any recent deploys to runtime? I don't see any deploys in the last hour.

Eng Runtime: we rolled a minor kernel fallback earlier but that was in eu-central, not us-west.

Telemetry: attaching quick metrics snapshot: 
```
ventus11b_usw2:
  TPM: baseline 120 -> 380 (5m)
  RPM: baseline 600 -> 1850
  errors(5xx): 0.8% -> 5.1%
  p95 latency: 180ms -> 920ms
```

Support Ops: two customer tickets flagged increased latency on features using ventus11b; customers affected across multiple orgs but primarily sandbox/testing.

Kai: initial mitigation plan: 1) reduce RPM/TPS for ventus11b family to throttle noisy tenants 2) enable model fallback to ventus7b for non-critical traffic 3) disable function-calling on ventus11b to reduce KV pressure.

Maria: agree. let's do staged throttle: lower per-model RPM by 50% first and apply tenant carve for top noisy tenants. If no improvement in 5m, do 75%.

Raj: prepping commands. staging them here for review: 
```
# reduce family RPM ceiling
redwoodctl quota set --model-family ventus11b --rpm 925 --reason "emergency latency mitigation"
# disable funcall
redwoodctl model-config update ventus11b --feature funcall=false
# set tenant carve for tenantIDs 122, 337
redwoodctl tenant-quota set --tenant 122 --model-family ventus11b --rpm 200
redwoodctl tenant-quota set --tenant 337 --model-family ventus11b --rpm 250
```

Kai: ack. execute throttle now. Maria, Raj, I'll monitor traces and errors.

(oncall-bot): ACTION LOGGED: throttles applied by Kai at 4102034623.

Kai: applied family RPM to 925. funcall disabled. tenant carveouts applied for 122, 337. watching.

Telemetry: after 90s: errors down to 2.0%, p95 -> 480ms, TPM dropped to ~240. Improvement but still above target.

Maria: good trend. let's keep funcall disabled for 15m and keep throttle at 50% while we wait for kernel team to surface more.

Eng Runtime: investigating KV miss patterns; we see a small set of tenants issuing many short-lived prefixes causing cache eviction. proposal: enable short prefix caching for ventus11b (30s TTL) — low risk.

Raj: can we enable prefix caching quickly? command?

Eng Runtime: yes, running: 
```
redwoodctl runtime-config update --model-family ventus11b --cache.prefix_ttl=30s
```

(oncall-bot): RUNTIME CHANGE APPLIED at 4102034740 by Eng Runtime.

Telemetry: 3m after prefix cache enabled: p95 -> 240ms, errors -> 0.9%, TPM at ~200.

Kai: nice. cpu/gpu utilization is stable. rollback plan: if errors <1% and p95 <250ms for 10m we can start gradually restoring RPM to baseline.

Support Ops: notifying affected customers: "We've applied temporary throttles and a short-term caching change to improve latency. We'll update you once things stabilize."

Maria: set a reminder to re-enable funcall only after we validate KV hit rate steady for 30m. Keeping an incident note for postmortem.

Kai: I'll hand off to next oncall at 4102034800 with current state: throttles at 50%, funcall disabled, prefix cache ttl 30s, metrics improving. tagging @Support Ops for customer comms.

(oncall-bot): HANDOFF recorded. Incident remains open.

Raj: leaving commands I used in case of re-escalation. if we see a new spike, escalate to runtime infra and consider reducing family RPM to 500.

Kai: thanks team. postmortem owner: Maria. I'll create the incident thread with timelines.

Maria: noted. will collect eval prompts to check quality regressions from fallback.

Support Ops: customers updated, will re-open tickets if anything else shows up. :thumbsup:
